metadata.title: आदिवासी के बारे में भ्रम ज़्यादा और ज्ञान कम है । Know Adivasi Culture । Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description:
Odisha has at least 62 tribal groups, who speak 74 different tribal languages and dialects. In this episode of Main Bhi Bharat we take you to Mayurbhanj. This is a tribal dominated district of Odisha, and here we will introduce you to Santali, Kharia and Ho tribes. In this episode, we will try to understand the issue of mainstreaming of the various tribal groups of India.

#Odisha #Santal
